$comment: PKCE (RFC 7636) conformance vectors. The S256 challenge must be the base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the ASCII verifier, with '+' -> '-', '/' -> '_', and '=' padding removed. A mismatch means one SDK's OAuth flow is rejected by Google while the other's succeeds.

rfc7636_appendix_b.note: The verifier is the RFC 7636 Appendix B example.

verifier_rules.$comment: generateCodeVerifier must produce a value in this range using a cryptographically secure RNG.
